demand.interpretation: The operator authorized this isolated research run; no signed independent request or qualifying economic event is represented.

arithmetic_profile.field_encoding: signed integer z is encoded as z mod p
arithmetic_profile.signed_decode: residue r decodes to r when r <= (p-1)/2 and to r-p otherwise
arithmetic_profile.linear_rule: matrix-vector products and dot products are evaluated exactly in F_p
arithmetic_profile.relu_rule: decode to the centered integer, apply max(0,z), then encode in F_p
arithmetic_profile.selection_rule: compare centered integers; ties select the lowest index
arithmetic_profile.overflow_rule: field reduction after every addition and multiplication

event_universe.relation: append current k and v to the committed initial cache
field dot products q dot each cached key
centered-score argmax and selected cached value
centered-logit argmax with lowest-index tie break
token id and vocabulary token equality

commitment_profile.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, no NaN
commitment_profile.framing: ASCII domain, zero byte, then each byte-string prefixed by unsigned 64-bit big-endian length

measurement_profile.baseline: Execute the identical frozen causal block and serialize only its output object, with no commitments, code preprocessing, challenges, receipt, or verification.
